Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Contents 1 Overview 2 Setup 3 Turn 4 Game End Overview Place pieces to try to form a line whilst making sure there is always a spot for your opponent to place Setup If using the Pie rule, 2nd player may choose to swap pieces after 1st player's initial placement Turn On the first turn, Black places a piece on any space then adds the rod facing any direction After which, alternate turns by placing a piece on a space along the rod's direction and moving the rod to your piece and picking a direction for it to rest The rod must always point to at least 1 empty space Game End If a player makes a line of a pre-determined length, they win! If a player is unable to point the rod to an empty space, they lose! If a player makes a line but cannot place the rod, they win! [Rating: 7.2/10] Nice, simple, little game. you learn it immediately and then you start mind twisting. It has some original concept and you have to look at your move from a strange perspective that very loosely reminds me of Quarto. Interesting and worth be studied. It's not a 7.5 but just 7.2 because i perceive it as a purely tactical game, i don't see a strategic side of the game

[Rating: 7.5/10] The way the players are hamstrung by the rod creates a unique tension where you're constantly trying to create n-in-a-row threats and control your opponent so they can't do the same. Every move feels like it matters. A good luckless n-in-a-row game.
